Straight answers

Louisiana: your questions.

Can’t find yours? Call (205) 941-6115 — you’ll reach a person.

Do I need a permit for a steel building in Louisiana?

Permit rules are set by your county or city. Ask what is required for a building of your size, and whether engineered plans are needed. We supply engineered plans and can tell you what to ask.

Do you install in my part of Louisiana?

Type your ZIP on the service areas page and we’ll tell you straight.

What does steel gauge mean?

Gauge is steel thickness, and a lower number is thicker steel. Our standard frame is 14-gauge (12-gauge is the upgrade) and standard panels are 29-gauge (26-gauge for commercial buildings).

What is a clear-span building?

A clear-span building has no support posts inside. The roof trusses carry the load across the full width, so the whole floor is usable for parking, work and storage.
